authority.note: M5 deep dive. Screening scores are heuristics; EDHREC is a derived metric; goldfish tests are model evidence, never win rates. No list changes, no challenger registered or promoted, no swap decided (constraints 2, 6, 8). Cory decides.

universe.definition: Commander-legal cards in the deck's colour identity, not basic lands, not in the canonical list, from the sources below; screened, ranked by screening score and bounded to [200, 500] (ties by name).

sources.edhrec: EDHREC candidate vectors of the M3 evidence layer (commander page(s))
sources.spellbook: Commander Spellbook find-my-combos almostIncluded: the single missing piece
sources.oracle_hook: Oracle-text search on the bulk: text touches a mechanic named by the commander (grixis_refine HOOKS)
sources.package: type search: shares a signature creature type (>= 40% of >= 3 members) of a blueprint package
sources.new_card: earliest Scryfall printing on or after 2026-04-16
sources.rank_fill: only when the other sources give < 200: identity cards with a key role, by EDHREC overall rank

universe.always_kept: edhrec, spellbook, blueprint and relevant new cards, then the best niche (no EDHREC row) Oracle/package hits up to 60, then the rest by score
screen_rules: edhrec: 35 x min(1, inclusion / 0.40) + 25 x clamp(synergy / 0.25, -1, 1) (commander page; derived_metric)
rank: 15 x max(0, 1 - log10(EDHREC overall rank) / 4.5) (Scryfall edhrec_rank; derived_metric)
oracle_hook +12, package type +10, package role +4, blueprint candidate +15 (strategic_judgment / heuristic)
spellbook near-miss +8, +8 more when the variant is infinite (fact)
new card +5; a key role the list has <= 3 of +5; named by a blueprint anti-goal -25

triage.default_rule: top clamp(#tier A, 15, 40) by screening score

escalation_rules.dependency_analysis: completes an infinite Spellbook variant whose other pieces are all in the list
escalation_rules.new_card: new card (>= 2026-04-16) with an Oracle hook, package fit or Spellbook near-miss
escalation_rules.unusual_oracle_interaction: Oracle hook or package-type hit with no EDHREC row on the commander page (niche)
escalation_rules.package_gap: fits a required blueprint package that holds fewer than its min_count in the list
escalation_rules.rank_miss_suspected: EDHREC synergy >= 0.15 but inclusion < 0.10, or a blueprint-named candidate ranked outside the default set
escalation_rules.cap: at most 12 per reason by score; the overflow is listed by name in triage.escalation_overflow

primary.definition: mean per game of the mana spent on turns 1-6 (curve use); higher is better

secondary.definition: share of games with the commander cast by turn 4
share of games where a Spellbook combo is drawn and affordable by turn 8 (goldfish proxy, not a win rate)
minus the mean mulligans taken (higher is better)

limitations: Goldfish: one player, no opponents, no interaction, no combat; results are about the deck's own development, never win rates.

Model 1.1 adds: draw on resolution / enters triggers (incl. wheels and loot discards), upkeep/draw-step draw triggers, suspend timing, tutors (spell or enters trigger; to hand, top or battlefield; target = missing piece of the closest combo, else a blueprint tutor target, else an identity-core card, else the highest-MV legal card; no re-shuffle, which is distributionally identical), rituals (cast only when they enable an otherwise uncastable card), one-shot mana (sacrifice sources, doesn't-untap rocks, Jeweled Lotus for the commander only, spent only when needed), treasures from resolution / enters effects, and the conditions of Chrome Mox, Mox Amber, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, Paradise Mantle, Springleaf Drum (imprint / land discard / metalcraft / a legend's colours / an untapped non-mana creature).

Model 1.1 still leaves out: opponent-dependent draw (Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora), activated or repeating draw and tutors (Sensei's Divining Top, Tamiyo's Journal, Wishclaw Talisman), attack/cast/death triggers, Lion's Eye Diamond, sacrifice additional costs (Deadly Dispute, Culling the Weak: not paid; 'discard a card' additional costs are paid), X costs, Paradise Mantle's equip cost, graveyard tutors (Entomb, Buried Alive) and recursion, discard to hand size.
'Enters tapped unless ...' lands as untapped.
Combo pieces are 'assembled' when drawn; Commander Spellbook 'requires' conditions and the combo's own mana needs beyond the cards' mana values are ignored.

Fixed policy: commander first, then mana sources (conditions met), then tutors and draw spells (cheapest first), then highest mana value, then a ritual only if it enables an otherwise uncastable card; keep/bottom rule as recorded in 'mulligan'.
test_common.method: paired goldfish, 300 games on identical shuffles; the cut takes the add's library position; diff = swap - canonical per game; CI95 = mean ± 1.96·sd/√n of the per-game differences; verdict by grixis_paired.verdict (PREREG primary)
